task: Make `codemie-claude --resume <CodeMie session id>` resolve to the native Claude id, pass the native id to `claude -r`, and keep the session CodeMie-owned (EPMCDME-17189).

component_scope.label: XL
component_scope.affected: session-ownership resolver (resolveClaudeResumeSession), AgentCLI resume handling, core agent types (ResumeOwnershipResult contract), Claude agent plugin (resolveResumeOwnership), COMMANDS.md docs
component_scope.layers: Service (session resolution), Workflow (CLI resume flow), Agent-Tool (Claude plugin)

technical_risk.label: M
technical_risk.risk_factors: ID resolution ranking across multiple session records per CodeMie id (generation suffix, completed_ prefix, placeholder or unknown native ids); wrong resolution would mark a session external and drop telemetry; shared AgentCLI resume path used by every agent
technical_risk.mitigation: Native-id match still wins, change is additive (optional nativeResumeId on the result), only the --resume option is rewritten, resolver failures fall back to existing behaviour; unit, plugin-level and integration tests added, plus a review fix-up to the ranking logic

key_reasoning.reason: Four production components changed: session-ownership.ts (new resolveClaudeResumeSession with native/CodeMie id matching and record ranking), AgentCLI.ts (rewrites options.resume and RESUME_SESSION_ENV_KEY to the resolved native id), types.ts (ResumeOwnershipResult gains nativeResumeId) and claude.plugin.ts (resolver wiring). Base L, bumped to XL because AgentCLI.ts and types.ts are shared by every agent.
9 files per diffstat (6 modified, 3 new tests) across docs, src and tests; 3+ top-level directories gives L.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from L to XL: touches core shared AgentCLI.ts and the shared ResumeOwnershipResult contract in types.ts used by all agent adapters (the change is additive and optional, so this is a conservative bump)
